name: PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk serves as a holding company, with its core business revolving around the extraction and commercialization of metallurgical coal. The firm's operations are organized across three primary divisions: Mining, Metal Processing, and a segment for Other Services. This enterprise was established on September 25, 2007, and its corporate headquarters are located in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
